snippet.title: Overtrick | Gameplay and Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A trick-taking roguelike with style! Outplay your rivals, purchase special abilities, and dazzle 1920s high society with your unstoppable cardplay. Call your contract, follow suit, flush trumps, and claim the hand. This isn't your grandma's bridge club... this is Overtrick!

Demo available on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4101290/Overtrick/?beta=1

Join our Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/3RmNr28eWj
